'''Henni''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] lived on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] illegally among the [[Pilgrims]]. She was one of many Pilgrims who followed [[Matriarch/Legends|Matriarch]] [[Kolovish]] to Tython in the aftermath of the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Slaver/Legends|enslavement]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartels]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Henni only appears ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' if the [[Jedi Consular]] makes a Dark Side choice and kills [[Allia (Twi'lek)|Allia]] during the class mission "Rajivari's Legacy" on Tython. In this case, Henni will take her place during the player's confrontation with [[Nalen Raloch]] at the [[Vur Tepe|Forge]].
